info.title: NRCan Geolocation (geolocator.api.geo.ca)
info.description: Natural Resources Canada's keyless geolocation service — free-text Canadian place-name search returning ranked matches with coordinates. The old geogratis.gc.ca path 302s here; this host answers directly.

get.description: Returns a JSON ARRAY of matches, best first. Each match carries `title` ('Brantford, Brant, Ontario (City)'), `qualifier` ('LOCATION' for a real named place, 'INTERPOLATED_CENTROID' for road guesses), `type` (Geoname entries are settlements), `bbox`, and `geometry.coordinates` as [lon, lat]. Empty array = no such Canadian place.
